chunks: Verily God is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is the straight path.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is the Lord of both me and others, and why is He the straight path?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis as a foundational proof for the unity of divine lordship (Rububiyyah), underscores that true worship is the exclusive right of Allah, who is the sustainer of all creation. It serves as a practical directive for believers to align their acts of devotion solely with the Divine, avoiding shirk in both belief and practice. The identification of this monotheistic worship as the 'straight path' highlights its role as the unerring route to spiritual success and closeness to God.
